title: Smooth reciprocal of a nowhere zero complex function
statement: Use $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field] with their usual Euclidean structures. Let $m\geq1$, let $U\subseteq\mathbf R^m$ be open, and let $f:U\to\mathbf C$ be smooth, meaning real $C^\infty$ (all real coordinate derivatives of every finite order exist and are continuous). If $f(x)\ne0$ for every $x\in U$, then the pointwise reciprocal $x\mapsto f(x)^{-1}$ is smooth on $U$. The open set may be empty.
